name: @cdna/targeted-wasm
description: Isolated Rust/WASM full-reference aligner for targeted Nanopore

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../core-wasm && mamba run -n cdna-web wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../targeted-wasm/pkg --no-default-features --features targeted && mamba run -n cdna-web wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir ../targeted-wasm/pkg-web --no-default-features --features targeted
